items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: You can book online through our website, call us on +44 20 7946 0958, or pop into the salon. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance.

items.question: Do you cater for cats as well as dogs?
items.answer: Absolutely. We welcome cats, rabbits, and most small animals. Our team is trained to handle each species with specialist care.

items.question: What should I bring to a first visit?
items.answer: Please bring your pet's vaccination records, any medication they take, and a note of any allergies or sensitivities.

items.question: How long does a grooming session take?
items.answer: A standard groom takes around 60–90 minutes depending on breed and coat condition. Full spa treatments may take up to two hours.

items.question: Is my pet insured while in your care?
items.answer: Yes. We carry full public liability and professional indemnity insurance covering all animals in our care.
